meta.description: Official v1.10 benchmark baseline. 65 queries, variant full, top_k=50, rrf_k=20. v1.10 activates RERANKER_USE_HEADING_CONTEXT=True: the cross-encoder receives Document:<doc_id> + Section:<heading_path> prefix before chunk text. NOT an exact replica of the interactive production pipeline — same documented differences as v1.8.1 baseline (no query expansion, no pre-rerank MMR, top_k=50).
production_differences: No query expansion (production uses VARIANTS_COUNT=2 → 3 queries)
No MMR before reranker (production: MMR_ENABLED=True, diversity_mode=None)
top_k=50 fixed (production CLI default: 40 = 20 per variant x2)
Reranker: same (BGE cross-encoder with heading context active)

known_regressions.query: ¿Cómo se utilizan las restricciones en SDMX para limitar los valores permitidos?
known_regressions.note: Adding English doc_id/section headers to a Spanish query changes cross-encoder attention. Set RERANKER_USE_HEADING_CONTEXT=False to restore v1.9 text-only behaviour if cross-lingual recall is critical.

meta.baseline_notes: v1.10 supersedes v1.8.1 as the active CI baseline. R@5 +0.021, MRR +0.026, nDCG@10 +0.012 vs v1.8.1. R@10 -0.018 (acceptable tradeoff: LLM receives top-8 chunks, improving top-5 precision is the relevant signal). Use THIS baseline (v1.10) for future regression guards.
